meta.title: Application name, copied from the PRD.
meta.updated_at: Date this index was last written (YYYY-MM-DD).

ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.

actors.id: Stable kebab-case identifier, e.g. 'actor-admin'. Never changed after creation.
actors.name: Human-readable name, e.g. 'System Administrator'.
actors.description: One or two sentences describing who this actor is and what they do in the system.
actors.permissions: Summary of what this actor can see and do — e.g. 'full access', 'read-only', 'own records only'.
